always_validate_payload.why: Actions can be called with incomplete payloads

null_task_means_ended.why: SelectTask with null task indicates call/reservation ended

state_for_context.why: Redux state needed for context-aware decisions

verify_task_exists.why: Tasks removed asynchronously, always check existence
